response.rationale: These look like two different concepts. A ClubBooking is a club reserving all or half of the rink: it carries `rink: "whole" | "half"` and is stored in its own ClubBookingRepository, which also has rates. ClubService calls that repository, never BookingRepository. A Booking is an individual purchase for a session. It is used by RinkService.purchase, handlePaymentResult, cancelSession and expireOverdue, and by IceMonitorService.notifyHolders, which together describe a member or holder buying a place in a session. Both are bookings, but they have separate repositories, separate types and separate life cycles, so they model different real-world things.
